$comment: Question set for the pilot application. The website renders these fields from this file, and the backend validates against it, so the two can never drift apart. Edit here, not in the HTML.
title: Pilot application
intro: Tell us a little about yourself and why you want to fly with us.

questions.name: robloxUsername
questions.label: Roblox username
questions.hint: The name you appear under in Roblox.

questions.name: discordUsername
questions.label: Discord username
questions.hint: So we can find you when we reply.

questions.name: email
questions.label: Email address
questions.hint: Only used to contact you about this application.

questions.name: age
questions.label: Age
questions.hint: Roblox accounts must belong to players aged 13 or over.

questions.name: experience
questions.label: Previous aviation experience
questions.placeholder: Flight simulators, other Roblox servers, real aviation, or none at all.

questions.name: motivation
questions.label: Why do you want to join?

questions.name: agreedRules
questions.label: I have read the rules and agree to follow them.
